description_sq:
Disponojme per shitje apartament te tipologjise 2+1+2 tualete ne zonen e Astirit.
Apartamenti organizohet ne sallon ndenjeje me kuzhine te perbashket, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete si dhe ballkon i bollshem.
Ofrohet i mobiluar si ne foto, me nje arredim bashkekohor si dhe elektroshtepiake te markave prestigjoze.
Ideal per banim ose investim.
Post parkimi opsional me cmim ekstra.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni!
description_en: We have for sale an apartment of typology 2+1+2 toilets in the area of ​​Astir. The apartment is organized in a living room with a common kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a spacious balcony. It is offered furnished as in the photo, with contemporary furnishings and appliances of prestigious brands. Ideal for residence or investment. Optional parking post at extra cost. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
